_notes: Global seasonal multipliers (design doc section 2). Numbers marked placeholder in the doc are first guesses to tune. 'farm_output' scales every food yield; 'movement_cost' scales every tile's move cost; 'morale_drift' is a flat per-round change (used from build step 3); 'xp_gain' scales all XP (step 8); 'commander_pool_growth' is commanders added to the pool (step 8).
